# bugsink Provider

Manages resources on a Bugsink instance's canonical API (`/api/canonical/0/`).

~> `bugsink_team` and `bugsink_project` cannot currently be deleted through the API: `terraform destroy` on them fails by design and requires `terraform state rm` to detach. See each resource's documentation before adopting them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    bugsink = {
      source = "nmehlei/bugsink"
    }
  }
}

provider "bugsink" {
  endpoint = "https://bugsink.example.com"
  # token is sensitive - prefer the BUGSINK_TOKEN environment variable over
  # hardcoding it here, especially in version-controlled configuration.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Bugsink instance, e.g. `https://bugsink.example.com`.

### Optional

- `insecure` (Boolean) Allow a plain-HTTP endpoint. Only for local development against a disposable instance - never set this against a production endpoint.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for the Bugsink API. Falls back to the `BUGSINK_TOKEN` environment variable when unset; configuration fails if neither is present.
